item.title: Paul Hart's Year in Review
item.description: 2017 was a very good year for me. Our multi-platform documentary for TVO, Little India: Village of Dreams premiered on Canada Day. The 2017 Canadian Country Music Awards included two nominations that I edited in the “Best Country Special or Production” category. Next I'll be directing and editing Jamie Hart’s pilot.
